$comment: Unity packages this repo's synced sources need in order to COMPILE. The Unity project is not a git repository, so its Packages/manifest.json is not version controlled and a rebuilt or restored project silently loses these. checked by scripts/check-unity-packages.mjs.

com.nyx.gamecraft.neededBy: the reusable game-definition, adapter, composition, rule, and verification boundary
com.nyx.gamecraft.why: The Games Master is the proving consumer for the standalone GameCraft Unity package.
com.nyx.gamecraft.note: The local sibling link keeps development independent of GitHub credentials; switch to the private v0.1.0 tag after a clean authenticated consumer install passes.

com.unity.ai.navigation.why: NavMeshSurface, for baking the prologue's walk corridor. The runtime query API is in com.unity.modules.ai and was always present; only baking needs this package.
com.unity.ai.navigation.note: 2.0.13 is the version Unity 6000.5.3f1 pins in its own package manifest. 2.0.8 fails to compile against this editor, calling the now obsolete-as-error Object.GetInstanceID().

com.unity.animation.rigging.neededBy: the production Aldric and player-body Animator/IK prefab contract
com.unity.animation.rigging.why: RigBuilder and contact constraints will layer hand/card IK over authored Humanoid clips without letting Animator events become rules authority.
com.unity.animation.rigging.note: Verified against Unity's official registry metadata and the com.unity.animation.rigging-1.4.1.tgz bundled with Unity 6000.5.3f1. Its package.json requires Unity 6000.0.23f1 or newer; 1.4.1 also removes deprecated InstanceID API usage present in 1.4.0-era code.
